description: Collatz delay distribution follows power laws like SOC systems (sandpiles, earthquakes). Scale-free behavior without parameter tuning.
mathematical_formalization: P(delay > d) ~ d^{-alpha}, alpha ≈ 2-3. Analogous to Gutenberg-Richter law.
implementation_hypothesis: Compute delay distribution up to 10^8. Fit power law via MLE. Guide importance sampling.
experiment_seed: Delays for n=1..10^8, CCDF on log-log, power law fit.
